name: Reiko-sensei
source:
The school nurse at Shitama Academy, where the protagonist attends.

Perhaps due to her alluring beauty, rumors circulate within the academy that “Ms. Reiko lures boys into the infirmary...” She too, for a certain deep reason, is scheming to participate in the FeOlympics.

"Hey, you like it, don't you? Having a woman lick and lick your most important spot."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916184540/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/feralym/chara.html] archived official site[/url]]
